AI and Digital Tools

Which digital tool should I use?

Short Answer

Start with the need, audience and risks. Check which approved tools are already available and whether they meet accessibility, privacy and security requirements.

Detailed Guidance

Define the task and the people who will use the tool before comparing options. Check agency-approved products first, then consider accessibility, information sensitivity, integration, support and the effort required to maintain the solution.
